_comment: Merge these keys into ~/.pi/agent/settings.json -- do not replace that file.
`skills` is an array: KEEP any paths already there and APPEND the LifeOS one,
or Pi stops seeing the skills it already loads. Pi discovers a skill by the
SKILL.md in each subdirectory, so the path points at the parent of the skill
folders, not at an individual skill.
`enableSkillCommands` is what exposes them as /slash commands in a session.
`defaultModel` must name a model your Deflector actually routes -- see
GET /pi/models.json on the Deflector for the list it serves.
